#Text=Poor translation quality with new lines in the text
#Text=When translating the first paragraph of this website https://www.freebsd.org/ from English to Russian it produces nonsense.
#Text=When I copy the text to about:translations it's perfect.
#Text=I edited the HTML to remove new lines from the text and the quality of translation became good.
#Text=Does it make sense to remove new lines inside paragraphs before translating to prevent such cases?

#Text=TB 102 LTS - GUI not fully translated
#Text=Hello!
#Text=Many parts of the GUI of the release aren't translated in the Portuguese (pt-PT) version.
#Text=For example, the menu option “OpenPGP Key Manager” is in English.
#Text=And the radio buttons in the import/export are also untranslated.
#Text=RTL - shopping sidebar container flickers on the right side when opening/closing the sidebar
#Text=STR:
#Text=1. Enable bidi mode in Browser Toolbox (alternatively: load Firefox in RTL language)
#Text=2. Make sure sidebar feature is enabled and profile is opted in
#Text=2. View product page ([example](https://www.amazon.com/SteelSeries-Arctis-Multi-System-Gaming-Headset/dp/B0B8Q4CR52/)) and ensure shopping sidebar is visible
#Text=3. Close sidebar with urlbar shopping icon or the close button on the sidebar
#Text=Expected:
#Text=- there should be no sudden flicker on the right side of the page when closing/opening the sidebar in RTL mode
#Text=Actual:
#Text=- there is a slight flicker on the right side of the page, which is very distracting visually
#Text=Notes:
#Text=- this issue probably existed for a while, but I believe that it will be way more obvious once [we show sidebar animations](bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1858762).
#Text=- I tested this on MacOS and can't recall at the moment if it also occurs on other platforms
